name: Top Rail
description: A slim focus-aware accent rail along the top edge of the window. Its height, inset, softness, corner alignment and focused colours are independently riceable.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Focused height
parameters.description: Rail thickness while the window is focused (px)

parameters.name: Unfocused height
parameters.description: Rail thickness while the window is unfocused (px)

parameters.name: Corner alignment
parameters.description: Keeps the rail ends aligned with the window's top corners (px)

parameters.name: Horizontal inset
parameters.description: Additional inset from each corner-aligned end (px)

parameters.name: Edge softness
parameters.description: Anti-aliased softness of the rail edges (px)

parameters.name: Square when maximized
parameters.description: Remove the corner alignment inset while the window is maximized or fullscreen

parameters.name: Focused colour
parameters.description: Rail colour at the ends of the focused window

parameters.name: Focused highlight
parameters.description: Rail colour at the centre of the focused window

parameters.name: Unfocused colour
parameters.description: Rail colour while the window is unfocused
